text: `for d in 018 019 020; do awk -v id="## DEC-$d " 'index($0,id)==1{p=1;next} /^## DEC-/{p=0} p' /mnt/vault/Portfolio/containers/nice-dns/decisions.md | grep -c '^- \*\*\(Decided\|Reason\|Source\):'; done` prints `3` three times. Check the field names against the file's existing entries first and use theirs.
why: The decisions register is in the vault (/mnt/vault, not a git repo), so a break patch cannot be applied from the repo. Watched by hand: the Test: loop printed 0 0 0 before the insert and 3 3 3 after; the pre-insert copy is kept in the session scratchpad.
